classification.classification_reason: A story about a pianist rescued from a cruise ship after nine hours in the ocean.

content.title: Cruise Ship Pianist Rescued After Nine Hours in the Pacific Ocean
content.caption: A pianist onboard Royal Caribbean's Ovation of the Seas is expected to survive after being rescued from the Pacific Ocean nearly 20 miles offshore.
